result.analyst_notes: Confident, aspirational framing led by vision and performance language. Safety is the stated top priority; workforce, communities and partners are addressed before shareholders. Commitments are largely absolute ('always', 'highest'). Uses first-person plural throughout. Shareholder value appears in strategy section, framed as a result to deliver.
